name: Darwin Initiative Main

funder.name: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra)

summary: UK government grants of £200,000 to £1 million for two- to five-year projects that conserve or restore biodiversity while reducing poverty in eligible countries, with a two-stage application.

geography.label: Darwin Initiative Round 32 eligible countries (within listed biodiversity hotspots)

reporting: Annual and half-year progress reports, reviewed each year, against the project's objectives (outputs, ethics, environmental impact), plus a final report at the end of the award.

status.quote: Applications to Round 32 of Darwin Initiative Main are now closed.

opens.quote: The latest application round opened on Friday 22nd May 2026.

deadline.quote: Stage 1 deadline for applications: Monday 20th July 2026.

administered_by.quote: NIRAS Darwin Initiative Administrator; first point of contact for projects and applicants.

geography.quote: In Round 32, parts of 36 countries are eligible.

access.quote: All applications should be submitted via the Flexi-Grant application portal.

window.quote: Applications to Darwin Initiative Main are a two-stage process.

amount.quote: Darwin Initiative Main invites applications for projects between £200,000 and £1,000,000 that deliver strong results for biodiversity conservation and poverty reduction.

reporting.quote: Projects must provide Annual and Half Year progress reports that are reviewed each year.
